title: A crash report
description:
Catch failures and write a report with the context that helps to fix them.

```
crash-2026-11-20.txt
  what: std::out_of_range: vector::at
  where: loading level 3
  recent log: 8 lines
  game state: player at (12, 4), 3 enemies, frame 5521
```
hints: Write the report with as little work as possible: a program that just failed may be in a bad state (lesson 8.04).
Print the ring buffer from `g_next` round to `g_next - 1` so the oldest line comes first.
requirements: Wrap the main loop in `try` / `catch (const std::exception&)` and a `catch (...)`.
Keep the last 8 log lines in a ring buffer to include.
A "breadcrumb" string set by each phase (`loading level 3`) tells where it happened.
On Windows, a stretch is `SetUnhandledExceptionFilter` and `MiniDumpWriteDump` for real crashes.
stretch: Add a crash dump on Windows and open it in Visual Studio.
